name: Melchizedek
bio:
Melchizedek is king of Salem and priest of the Most High God, who met Abram on his return from defeating the coalition of kings led by Chedorlaomer and rescuing Lot (Genesis 14:17-20). He brought out bread and wine for Abram and blessed him: "Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth: and blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand." Abram then gave him a tenth of everything.

Melchizedek appears directly in Scripture only this once, yet his unique identity as both king and priest made him an important figure of later typology. Psalm 110 prophesies that the Messiah would be "a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek," and Hebrews develops this further, presenting Melchizedek as a picture of Christ's eternal priesthood, surpassing the Levitical priestly system (Hebrews 7).
